disqualifier.note: Independent install-timers request flags. uninstall true takes the uninstall path and ignores refresh; uninstall false with refresh absent, false, or true all install. No combo is rejected.

evidence.note: The handler copies both flags onto WorktreeRemovalRequest. validateRemovalRequest fails !archive && deleteBranch, so deleteBranch implies archive. The other three pairs proceed.

notes: Raw remove options. Distinct from the already-designed WorktreeRemovalRequest owner; same implication. Modes: remove, archive, archive-and-delete-branch.
